declarations.description:
Read-only key/value pairs for a detail page: the Descriptions of antd and the DescriptionList of Polaris. Each
`c2-description-item` child is one pair. The items flow into as many columns as fit, up to
`--c2-description-list__grid--columns`, each at least `--c2-description-list__grid--min-column-width` wide, so the
same markup is three columns on a wide page and one on a phone without a media query. An item spans the full row
with `--c2-description-item--grid-column: 1 / -1`.

Whether a label sits above its value or beside it is CSS too: `--c2-description-item__label--width` set to a
length puts the label beside the value, and the value still wraps under it when the item is narrower than the
label plus `--c2-description-item__value--min-width`. Set the item variables on the list and every item inherits them.

Items with several values (`c2-description-value` children) line up in columns; `value-labels` names those
columns in a header row and `label-heading` heads the label column. The header hides itself when the values stack,
and each value then shows its column name. A list with value columns lays its items out in a single column.

The list is exposed as a `list` and every item as a `listitem` holding a `term` and its `definition`.

```html
<c2-description-list aria-label="Customer">
  <c2-description-item label="Name">Ada Lovelace</c2-description-item>
  <c2-description-item label="Email">ada@example.com</c2-description-item>
  <c2-description-item label="Plan">Business</c2-description-item>
</c2-description-list>
```

declarations.description:
One label and value pair of a `c2-description-list`. The label comes from the `label` attribute, or from the
`label` slot when it needs markup (an icon, a tooltip); the value is the item's content, which can be anything from
plain text to a badge, a link or an avatar. An item with no value shows `empty-text`, so a missing field reads as
"—" instead of an empty gap.

An item can hold several values, one `c2-description-value` each: the price of a feature in each plan, a metric
this month and last. They line up in equal columns across the items of the list, and the list's `value-labels`
names those columns. The layout adapts on its own: when the label and the columns no longer fit on one line the
columns move under the label, and when the columns themselves no longer fit (each narrower than
`--c2-description-item__value-column--min-width`) the values stack, each with its column name as a caption.

members.description: The label. The `label` slot takes its place when it has content.

members.description: Text shown while the value is empty. An empty string shows nothing.

members.name: hasValue
members.description:
Whether the default slot holds an element or non-blank text. The server cannot see the light DOM, so it renders
every item as filled; a client that adopts that server markup keeps the same value until hydration is done, then
reads the real one, or Lit reports a hydration mismatch.

members.name: valueCount
members.description: How many `c2-description-value` children the item has; zero renders the default slot as one value.

members.name: values
members.description: The item's values, looking through wrappers a framework puts around them (Astro islands, `display: contents` hosts), but not into a nested item.

members.name: readHasValue
members.description: Content of the default slot only: a label or an action in a named slot is not a value.

members.name: syncValues
members.description: Hands each value its column name, and tells it whether the columns wrapped onto rows of their own.

attributes.name: label

declarations.description:
One value of a `c2-description-item` that has several, such as a plan's price in each of three plans. Values line
up in columns across the items of a list, and the list's `value-labels` names the columns. When the columns no
longer fit, the values stack under their label and each one shows its column name as a caption; the caption is
always there for assistive technology, which reads it with the value.
declarations.name: DescriptionValue

cssProperties.description: Width of the caption beside a stacked value.
cssProperties.name: --c2-description-value__caption--width

cssParts.description: The column name before the value. It is shown only while the values are stacked, and visually hidden otherwise.
cssParts.name: caption

cssParts.description: The wrapper around the default slot, which holds the value.
cssParts.name: content

members.name: caption
members.description: Column name, handed down by the item from its list's `value-labels`.

members.name: stacked
members.description: Whether the item's values are stacked, so the caption is shown.
